name: yf_compare_stocks
description:
Side-by-side valuation snapshot for up to 10 tickers from Yahoo Finance (yfinance Ticker.info per symbol).
Returns: {comparison: [{symbol, name, market_cap, pe_ratio (trailing), dividend_yield, 52w_high, 52w_low}]}; a symbol that fails is left out.
Inputs (* required): symbols* (comma-separated, e.g. "AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL"; only the first 10 are used).
Price history for several tickers: yf_multi_ticker_history; full detail: yf_stock_info; peers: openbb_equity_compare_peers. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbols": "AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL"}
